text_block_list.name: Recording Sound
text_block_list.text: "—Lucky Lilac surges from the outside!"

text_block_list.name: Recording Sound
text_block_list.text:
"From the outside, number 11 Lucky Lilac catches up!
Lucky Lilac crosses the finish line!
――Lucky Lilac takes the win with a brilliant surge!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
――...If Lala makes her move from here...
...I'll accelerate... and once more――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding-dong♪)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
!
It's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"If you're still awake,
wrap things up and get some sleep.
Let's discuss it tomorrow. Good night."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...I got found out.
I really need to sleep now."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
I can't wait to run...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Classic races are finally underway...
Their first leg is the Tiara route's Oka Sho.
The fierce battles kick off from Hanshin Racecourse—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text: —Well, it's gotta be Lala-chan! She's definitely taking the Tiara route this year♪

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
A good start, smoothly finding a great position, running her own race... like a true honor student!
Above all, I just love her elegant presence♡

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chan has incredible legs too, but...
in terms of polish right now, maybe Lala-chan is ahead?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"The showdown between the two hottest topics...
I can't wait~♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The crowd's expectations favor Lucky Lilac—
Just as expected, she will likely be
the greatest rival this time.
choice_data_list: 1,600m might be a bit too short for you.
1,600m might be a bit too short for you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes... My greatest weapon is my late charge.
Depending on how the race unfolds, I might not make it in time.
choice_data_list: Let's be careful about the timing when making a move.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Right. Also... a late start could prove fatal. I'll need to focus on the gate even more than usual.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I've studied a lot, so I know how strong Lala is.
That's why I can't overthink things at the gate...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list: I think you can come from behind and win from any position.
I think you can overtake them from any position.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Exactly, I think so too!
And on top of that, we will—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Don't let your guard down, don't cut corners, and take a flawless victory.
...That's the plan, right!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Do you have any other advice or instructions?
choice_data_list: You don't need to worry about what comes after.
Don't get overwhelmed by the cheers.
This is the rival you've been aiming for. Let's take a total victory!
This is the rival you've been aiming for. Let's take a total victory!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Do you have any other advice or instructions?
choice_data_list: You don't need to worry about what comes after.
Don't get overwhelmed by the cheers.
This is the rival you've been aiming for. Let's take a total victory!
This is the rival you've been aiming for. Let's take a total victory!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Oh my, that is...
choice_data_list: I'll take really good care of you!
I'll take the absolute best care of you, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Meaning I should hit it with everything I've got, right?!
In that case, I leave the rest to you."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Alright then, I'm heading off!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's true!
The Classic races are amazing every single year.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Watching from the sidelines is totally different from being in the spotlight.
I have to make sure I don't get too carried away!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Alright then, I'm heading off!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
A complete victory...!
Yes, indeed!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I dove right in aiming for Lala, after all.
If I can win, it'll feel absolutely amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Alright then, I'm heading off!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!!
Lucky Lilac-chaaan!
Do your beeest!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your cheers.
Please continue to watch over me warmly.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it, the passion in the Classic races is on a whole 'nother level.
—Right, Ai-san?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
Competing against you in this atmosphere—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Winning.
It's going to feel so amazing!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, completely unfazed, huh?
Impressive as always.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I like that competitive spirit of yours.
When you bring it right at me, it gets me all fired up too."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Even so... the goal was "victory," wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Well then—it doesn't have to be the Tiara, right?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: My dream is the Triple Tiara... That's why I've run straight down the royal road of the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I know how amazing Ai-san is. Even so—
my determination for this race won't lose to anyone."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Aren't you quite
the feisty one yourself!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
But you know, Lala.
Today, right here! I want to beat you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let's see whose feelings are stronger...
Let's settle this!
